key_terms.ٱللات: Lat, a major pre-Islamic Arabian idol

ai.seo_question: Who are Lat and 'Uzza in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Surah An-Najm, Allah challenges the Quraysh's pre-Islamic polytheism by questioning their veneration of Lat and 'Uzza, two prominent female deities believed to be daughters of Allah. This rhetorical inquiry underscores the absurdity of attributing offspring to the Divine, a core tenet in Shia theological critiques of idolatry, while highlighting the transition from tribal animism to monotheistic purity.
